title: UsageEvent
description: One threshold crossing reported by a client. Never contains app names or exact minutes.

eventId.description: Client-generated; also the Firestore document ID, so uploads are idempotent.

type.description: bucket_reached: today's cumulative usage for label crossed bucketMinutes, once per bucket per day. session_threshold: one continuous session crossed the session limit (Android only, optional for the backend).

bucketMinutes.description: For session_threshold, the session limit that was crossed.
